fatal_errors: The proposed material and treatment are unrelated to the target HfNbTaTiZr alloy and its silicide oxidation-resistant coating.
Sulfuric-acid anodization normally produces a porous anodic alumina layer, contradicting the claimed porous-free barrier mechanism.
The quantitative oxidation reduction and boundary values are unsupported by cited evidence.
explanation: The response addresses oxidation resistance only at a generic level and substitutes anodized Al 6061 for the target additively manufactured refractory high-entropy alloy. It misses the silicide coating, self-healing (Zr,Hf)O2 filling mechanism, vacuum/hydrogen processing, oxygen control, quench-stabilized beta-BCC phase, and approximately 700-fold reduction in parabolic oxidation rate. The untreated-alloy control and comparative oxidation test are directionally reasonable, but the test does not reproduce the target conditions, the oxidation metric is not a parabolic rate constant, and no evidence supports the selected parameters or numerical predictions.
